summary: Phase 1 ACE Driver Hub fully verified. 34/34 backend pytest cases pass (health, auth login/me/register, role enforcement, stats overview for all 8 slugs, full CRUD for all 8 modules, unknown-slug 404, _id leak check). 18/18 Playwright frontend flows pass (login render, invalid credentials error, login -> hub navigation, 8 module cards with count badges, logout visible, click each of 8 module cards -> module page with table, Add Record dialog create flow, search filter, delete row, logout, unauth /-> /login redirect).
action_items: Minor: Login.jsx calls navigate('/', {replace: true}) directly inside render body (lines 14-16). React logs warning: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component'. Wrap the redirect in useEffect to avoid the warning. Non-blocking — login still works.
Minor: Module count badges briefly show '—' on first hub render until /api/stats/overview resolves. Consider a small skeleton or default of 0. Cosmetic only.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx: setState-in-render warning (navigate() called during render of an authenticated user). Move into useEffect.
ProtectedRoute correctly handles undefined/null/object user state — good.
Backend correctly excludes _id from all responses (find with {'_id': 0} projection). Verified by test_list_seeded assertion.
JWT secret is committed in backend/.env — acceptable for prototype; flag for production rotation.
test_credentials: admin@acedriverhub.com / Admin@123 (seeded Admin). ReadOnly/Manager/Allocator test users created at runtime via /api/auth/register with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Tests create-and-delete records prefixed with TEST_ across all 8 module collections. All cleaned up at end of each test. Test users with TEST_ email prefix remain in users collection (not deleted by tests).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_ace_backend.py is parametrised across all 8 module slugs. Re-use as regression suite. Frontend: all data-testid selectors stable (login-*, module-card-{slug}, module-count-{slug}, module-table, module-row-{id}, module-delete-{id}, module-add-button, module-search-input, create-dialog, create-field-{key}, create-dialog-submit, logout-button). Backend uses Bearer JWT in Authorization header (NOT cookies). UUID string ids, no Mongo _id leak verified.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests in this iteration.
